name: security-audit-skill
description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
one_liner: A free toolkit that turns an AI coding assistant into a structured security auditor, finding and double-checking real vulnerabilities in a codebase.
buyer: An independent security consultant or small pentest shop who wants to multiply how many codebases they can audit without hiring more analysts.
business_use_cases: A freelance security consultant uses it to do a first-pass automated audit on client codebases, then spends their billable hours only on triaging and confirming the real findings.
A startup's engineering lead runs it before a funding round or SOC2 push to catch obvious vulnerabilities before paying for a full professional pentest.
A boutique security firm builds a productized 'rapid audit' offering priced below a traditional pentest, using this skill as the core engine.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a flat-fee 'automated security audit' report to small startups who can't afford a full traditional pentest.
Use it internally to cut the hours a boutique security consultancy bills per engagement, increasing margin on existing retainer clients.

steal_this: Run it against a client's or your own side project's codebase this weekend and package the resulting report as a paid 'security health check' offer.
